jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Finance Manager
Martin, TN USA

Come build something that matters.

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.

The Job:
As a Finance Manager, you’ll be part of our Tools & Outdoor Global Supply Chain Finance team working as an on-site employee.    You’ll get to:
- Drive business cadences including but not limited to month end close, Forecasting, Operating Plan and risk mitigation.
- Perform variance analysis of accounts as needed.
- Provide costing support for Annual Cost Update/Analysis.
- Maintain the MAPICS general ledger (tie outs, roll overs, chart of accounts, statement formats, etc.).
- Assist with managerial accounting in support of plant operations, including managing 1 direct report (Finance Analyst).
- Coordinate distribution, loading and tie-out for SG&A forecast targets.
- SG&A Budget Management and Headcount tracking.
- Spearhead process improvements that deliver efficiency improvements & impact business results.
- Lead a team with direct responsibility of the Annual Physical Inventory and monthly Cycle count program.
- Completes tax documents (Ex: TN sales tax returns, annual property tax returns, etc.).
- Reporting and Query capabilities to support sites, project teams, and general analysis.

The Person:
You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance.
- 4-7 years Accounting or Finance experience in a manufacturing environment.

- Proven problem solving skills, strong oral and written communicator, strong interpersonal skills.
- Demonstrated understanding & application of GAAP.
- Highly proficient in Excel, knowledge of Hyperion HFM .
- Effective verbal & written communication skills.
- Ability to effectively work across organizational boundaries, both cross functionally and with business and Finance leadership.
- Knowledge of AS400/Mapics system; ISO and/or SOX Compliance Standards.

The Details:
You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including:
- Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being.
- Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

And More:
We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:
- Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

- Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.
- Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences.
- Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!

jobs.title: Global Strategy Lead, Data Centers
jobs.description:
Global Strategy Lead, Data Centers – Remote
North America or East Coast preferred, United States
Come build something that matters.

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.

The Job:
As Global Strategy Lead, Data Centers, you’ll be part of our Stanley Engineered Fastening (SEF) team working as a remote employee.  You own the growth strategy, go-to-market execution and commercial performance for SEF’s Data Center vertical across North America, Europe and Asia. Based in North America, you will stand this vertical up from strategy through execution: defining where we play and how we win across hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data center customers, and across the EPC, OEM and equipment manufacturers who serve them.  Fastening-specific automation sits at the center of this role. Data center construction and equipment assembly are constrained by skilled labor availability and cycle time, and our automated installation and assembly technology is the sharpest edge we have. You will make the core of the vertical value proposition — and be equally credible discussing it in a customer’s engineering review and defending a three-year margin plan in a business review.

Vertical Strategy & Growth Framework
- Own the global Data Center vertical strategy — market sizing, segmentation, prioritization and a multi-year roadmap with clear where-to-play and how-to-win choices across all three regions.
- Develop and execute the annual strategic business plan for revenue, gross margin and share gain, with regional plans that roll up to a single global number.
- Continuously analyze target markets — hyperscale’s, colocation providers, EPC and MEP contractors, rack and enclosure OEMs, power distribution, busway and liquid cooling manufacturers — and define market-specific value propositions grounded in customer need.
- Convert industry signals — AI-driven capacity growth, liquid cooling adoption, modular and prefabricated construction, regional buildout cycles, supply chain shifts — into commercial action.

Fastening Application & Automation Leadership
- Serve as the global authority on engineered fastening applications in data center environments — rack and enclosure assembly, cable management and power distribution, cooling infrastructure, and vibration-sensitive joints.
- Identify technology gaps and innovation opportunities specific to the vertical
- Act as the conduct between the field and product development, translating application insight into the future-state solution and innovation pipeline.

Go-to-Market & Demand Generation
- Lead demand generation strategy and go-to-market execution, ensuring segmentation-based priorities are consistently deployed across regions.
- Define the global account targeting strategy; partner with regional sales leadership on account plans, specification strategy and named hyperscale and colocation pursuits.
- ·Direct vertical content, technical collateral, application case studies and campaign development in partnership with marketing.

Commercial Ownership
- Own the commercial health of the vertical — pipeline, revenue, gross margin, and funnel conversion — and drive corrective action where gaps emerge.
- Build the metrics, dashboards and reporting cadence that measure vertical success and inform resource allocation.

Global Stakeholder Management
- Align and influence a matrixed global network — regional sales leaders, product management, engineering, operations, marketing and finance across three regions — largely without direct authority.
- Lead and develop vertical resources, including direct and dotted-line team members across regions.
- Navigate regional differences in customer structure, buying behavior, construction practice and standards — adapting the global framework without fragmenting it.

The Person:
You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have:
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Marketing or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
- Minimum 8-10 years in marketing, sales, product management or business development within industrial, engineered products or construction-adjacent markets.
- Deep, demonstrable data center market knowledge — the customers, buying cycle, delivery model and technical requirements. Prior experience serving hyperscale, colocation or data center construction ecosystems is preferred.
- Direct experience with engineered fastening applications and with fastening-specific or assembly automation.
- Track record of building a growth strategy from market analysis through to an executed commercial plan, owning revenue and margin outcomes.
- Proven influence across a global matrix spanning multiple regions and cultures.
- Critical thinking and problem-solving: synthesize findings from analysis and draw clear, defensible conclusions.
- Works across US, EU, and Asia time zones
- Occasional domestic and international travel (10–20%)

The Details
You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including:
- Meical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being.
- Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

And More

- Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.
- Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our Lean Academy, Coursera® and online university.
- Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect, Business Transformation
Job Description:  The Solutions Architect will be responsible for designing and implementing technical solutions that meet the complex needs of our internal customers. This role requires a deep understanding of business needs, data engineering, cloud computing, networking, and storage solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work closely with internal teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance solutions.

Essential Job Functions
Solution Design and Architecture:
- Design and architect customized data solutions that meet specific internal customer requirements, including compute, storage, networking, and cloud integration.
- Develop high-level and detailed designs in collaboration with IT, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security of the solutions.

Internal Customer Engagement and Requirements Gathering:
- Engage with internal customers to understand their business needs, technical requirements, and challenges.
- Conduct detailed requirements analysis and translate business needs into technical specifications.

Technical Leadership:
- Provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, from initial concept and design to implementation and post-deployment support.
- Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and other internal teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions and change.

Technology Evaluation and Selection:
- Evaluate and recommend technologies, products, and services that align with internal customer needs and industry standard methodologies.
- Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and trends in the industry to inform solution design.

Proof of Concept and Testing:
- Develop and lead proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives to validate proposed solutions.
- Communicate benefits of new concepts to internal teams and gauge readiness.
- Oversee testing and validation of solutions to ensure they meet performance, security, and reliability standards.

Documentation and Knowledge Transfer:
- Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of solution designs, configurations, and deployment procedures.
- Provide knowledge transfer and training to internal teams on the implemented solutions.

Continuous Improvement:
- Identify opportunities for improving solution design processes, tools, and methodologies.
- Contribute to the development of best practices and standards for solution architecture within the organization.
- Advise on business risks and deficiencies with actionable recommendations to leadership.

Additional Duties:
Handle additional duties as assigned by Management.​

Job Requirements

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree is preferred.

Experience:
- Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in a role of developing technical solutions for internal use, with a focus on data engineering, application development, and analytics.
- Proven experience in designing and implementing complex technical solutions in the data analytics or technology industry.

Skills:
- Strong organizational and project management skills.
- Strong understanding of data systems technologies, including servers, storage, networking, virtualization, and cloud platforms.

Position Summary:

This position is responsible for supporting the transition to Lean/SPS Manufacturing at the facility level. Primary responsibility is to ensure there is an effective transformation from traditional batch manufacturing to Lean/SPS Manufacturing by removing waste from the value stream and improving throughput to develop the future state value stream map for the facility. The Continuous Improvement Coordinator will coordinate these activities with the Continuous Improvement Manager.

Essential Functions:

· Contribute to the manufacturing facility to achieve productivity, inventory, quality, throughput, space and safety objectives established for the facility.
· Support the 5S process within the facility.
· Support the training and education plan facility wide to ensure associates possess the knowledge and skill required to implement and maintain Lean/SPS efforts
· Continuously perform all required tasks in a safe manner, adhering to all established safety rules and procedures. Must take immediate action to correct and/or report any unsafe conditions and hazards.
· Take an active role in caring for the equipment to prevent breakdowns and defects and help increase overall equipment efficiency through 5S, TPM (total productive maintenance), and other Lean Manufacturing initiatives directed by the Sedalia site.

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stanley Black & Decker  steht als weltweit führender Anbieter für Werkzeuge und Zubehör sowie für Befestigungslösungen seit 1843 an der Spitze der Innovation. Unsere renommierten Marken DEWALT, BLACK+DECKER, CRAFTSMAN und STANLEY sind gleichbedeutend mit Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit.
Unser Segment  STANLEY® Engineered Fastening  ist dabei weltweit führend im Bereich der präzisen Befestigungs- und Montagelösungen und bestrebt, Effizienz und Exzellenz in den Bereichen Automobil, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Industrie voranzutreiben. In unserer Tochtergesellschaft  Tucker GmbH  in Gießen/Linden entwickeln, fertigen und vertreiben wir mit ca. 1200 hochqualifizierten Mitarbeitern/-innen Konzeptlösungen für Befestigungs- und Verbindungstechnik für unsere globalen Kunden in der Automobilindustrie. Innovation und Kreativität stehen dabei im Mittelpunkt unserer Unternehmenskultur.

Verstärken Sie uns mit Ihrer Expertise und werden Sie Teil unseres Teams in Gießen in Vollzeit als

Continuous Improvement Engineer (m/w/d)

Ihre Rolle:
Der Ingenieur für Continuous Improvement ist dafür verantwortlich, Strategien sowie Projekte zur Steigerung der betrieblichen Effizienz, Kostensenkung sowie zur Verbesserung der Produkt- oder Dienstleistungsqualität zu identifizieren, zu entwickeln, umzusetzen sowie den Bereich in diesen Tätigkeitsfeldern zu unterstützen und zu beraten. In dieser Funktion werden Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen und andere Methoden zur Prozessoptimierung eingesetzt, um nachhaltige Verbesserungen umzusetzen.

The Job:
As a Quality and Continuous Improvement Engineer, you’ll be part of our team working as an onsite employee.  The Quality And Continuous Improvement Engineer, in accordance with Product Group policies, provides for the effective control of quality as required for the Plant’s operations through determination and regulation of product conformance, and the evaluation and improvement, where necessary, of manufacturing and supplier quality performance. - Provides and maintains measures of the Plant's quality performance in terms of quality costs, customer returns and complaints, product conformance, and manufacturing and supplier performance. Establishes quality performance goals.  Reports and takes action when goals are exceeded.

Lead Supply Chain AI strategy execution and use case delivery
·       Partner with Supply Chain leaders, functional experts, and IT to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-value AI use cases aligned to business strategy.
·       Serve as the primary interface between business users and technical teams for AI capability development across platforms such as  Kinaxis, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Zenlytic, MCP, and Microsoft Foundry .
·       Translate business problems into AI product requirements, user stories, workflows, and governance needs.
·       Oversee multiple cross-functional, high-visibility initiatives with diverse stakeholders and limited oversight.
·       Drive experimentation, prototyping, and scaling of AI-enabled solutions that improve planning, decision-making, productivity, and operational visibility.
Build and steward AI agents and intelligent workflows
·       Design, configure, test, and continuously improve AI agents and copilots that support Supply Chain planning, analytics, and business processes.
·       Act as a hands-on maker and developer of agents, combining business process knowledge with technical fluency to create practical, user-centered solutions.
·       Define agent behaviors, prompts, workflows, integrations, escalation paths, and success metrics to ensure solutions are reliable, useful, and scalable.
·       Partner with IT and enterprise platform teams to enable secure integrations, data access, orchestration, and deployment of AI capabilities.
·       Evaluate emerging AI tools and patterns to determine fit-for-purpose applications within the Supply Chain ecosystem.
Establish governance, adoption, and responsible AI practices
·       Help define standards, guardrails, and governance for AI development and usage within Supply Chain, including data quality, security, compliance, and human-in-the-loop decision processes.
·       Ensure AI initiatives remain aligned with approved roadmaps, investment priorities, governance standards, and platform strategies
·       Develop repeatable processes for intake, prioritization, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI use cases and agents.
·       Partner with business and technical stakeholders to improve data readiness, data availability, and process consistency required for AI success.
·       Monitor solution performance, user adoption, and business outcomes, using insights to refine roadmaps and investment priorities.
Enable data-driven decisions and organizational capability
·       Lead development of AI-enhanced dashboards, insights, and decision-support tools that improve visibility and streamline operations.
·       Provide strategic and ad hoc analysis to support Supply Chain leadership and transformation initiatives.
·       Mentor analysts, product owners, and business partners in AI literacy, use case framing, and adoption of new tools and ways of working.
·       Break down work for team members, contractors, and technical partners, ensuring priorities are clear and outcomes are delivered across multiple projects.
·       Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, continuous learning, and practical value creation.
Lead analytics development and insight delivery
·       Lead the development of dashboards, reports, and business-facing analytics solutions using  Power BI  and  Zenlytic .
·       Partner with stakeholders to define KPIs, metrics, and reporting needs that support Supply Chain planning and operations.
·       Improve access to trusted, actionable insights through scalable, user-friendly, and well-governed analytics products.
·       Identify opportunities to integrate analytics solutions with AI agents and copilots to streamline decision-making and business workflows.

The Person:
You are energized by learning, building, and leading through change. You are comfortable operating at the intersection of business, data, and technology, and you know how to turn emerging AI capabilities into real business value. You are equally comfortable discussing planning workflows with business users, defining requirements with IT, and rolling up your sleeves to prototype or configure intelligent solutions. You bring strong judgment, curiosity, and a pragmatic mindset to innovation.
You also have:
·       Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, supply chain, information systems, analytics, or a related field.
·       6+ years of experience in supply chain analytics, data & analytics, digital product management, AI/automation, or related roles.
·       2+ years of experience developing, configuring, or enabling  AI agents, machine learning and/or workflow-based automation solutions .
·       Experience in  Supply Chain Planning  and strong understanding of supply chain processes, decision points, and operational workflows.
·       Experience leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders across business and IT organizations.
·       Experience translating business needs into technical requirements, product roadmaps, and scalable digital or analytics solutions.
·       Familiarity with enterprise AI and analytics platforms such as  Kinaxis, Microsoft Copilot, Zenlytic, MCP, Microsoft Foundry, Power BI, Snowflake, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, Python  strongly preferred.
·       Proficiency in data and analytics concepts including data pipelines, semantic models, data quality, and integration design.
·       Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to evaluate complex scenarios and make sound decisions in ambiguous environments.
·       Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and rapid experimentation.
·       Strong communication skills, with the ability to serve as a translator between technical teams and business stakeholders.
·       Experience mentoring analysts and leading matrixed teams, contractors, or external partners.
·       Initiative, resilience, and willingness to challenge the status quo to drive meaningful outcomes.
·       Comfortable with ambiguity and able to create structure, priorities, and momentum in evolving spaces.

jobs.description:
SR Manager, Supply Chain Risk and Response – Prepare – Hybrid
New Britian, CT, United States
Come build something that matters.

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? The Job

As a Sr. Manager, you will strengthen our global supply chain preparedness and resilience by leading structured, data-driven risk identification, assessment, and prioritization across materials, suppliers, and operations.

The role is responsible for improving resilience-based decision-making through the evaluation of critical vulnerabilities, the application of risk-ranking methodologies based on business impact, financial exposure, and time-to-recover, and the alignment of mitigation actions to enterprise priorities.

The role will be highly collaborative with cross functional leaders (procurement, manufacturing, logistics, finance, etc.) to develop pre-vetted mitigation strategies, execute scenario planning exercises, and maintain dynamic playbooks.

The role will drive stronger governance, preparedness routines, and leadership reporting to enhance the organization’s ability to anticipate, absorb, and recover from supply disruptions.

- Improve resilience-based decision-making by identifying critical vulnerabilities and aligning mitigation actions to business impact.

- Build stronger cross-functional routines to improve readiness for potential supply disruptions.

- Risk assessment and prioritization frameworks
- Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word for executive reporting and storytelling

- Exceptional executive presence and stakeholder management skills (ability to influence functional VPs, plant managers etc)
- Experience operating in complex, multi-site manufacturing or global supply chain environments, including exposure to geopolitical and macroeconomic risks affecting global supply networks.
- Excellent Analytical and data drive decision making skills, with the ability to translate complex risk data into clear action plans

Procurement Systems Lead-Hybrid
Towson, MD or Valley City, OH

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. The Job:
The Procurement Systems Lead is the primary operator for procurement technology, process, and spend analytics, reporting to the Senior Manager. Procurement Leadership sets direction and priorities. This role turns that direction into movement: prioritized work, owned timelines, clean systems, trusted spend data, and measurable results.
This is not a pure strategy seat and not a ticket-only systems analyst role. The right person can sit in a planning meeting, leave with intent, and then drive execution across people, process, platforms, and analytics. When the work requires it, they get into the system themselves: configurations, integrations, classification, data quality, reporting, and exception handling.

How This Role Operates
- Translates strategy into execution – breaking it into a sequenced plan with owners, dates, and decision points.
- Moves work forward independently. Escalates only when a true decision, resource, or tradeoff is needed.
- Gets technical when required: inspects records, tests workflows, traces data issues, reviews spend classifications, documents configurations, and partners directly with IT, vendors, category managers, and power users.
- Builds reliability. Prefers durable process and system design over one-off heroics.

Core Responsibilities
Systems ownership & execution
- Owns the lifecycle of procurement systems (P2P, sourcing, contract, supplier, catalog, and spend analytics) — from requirements and design through roadmap execution, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization.
-  Translates business needs into system configuration — workflows, approvals, roles, catalogs, integrations, and reporting — while maintaining documentation including process maps, runbooks, and user guides.
- Runs the operating rhythm for all systems work: backlog management, cross-functional coordination with Procurement, Finance, Legal, IT, and business units, and partnership with vendors on integrations, data feeds, and incident resolution.
- Tracks what matters — adoption, cycle time, exception rates, data quality, and compliance — and reports progress in plain language.

Spend analytics and category support
- Owns the spend analytics platform and operating model (Sievo or comparable) — setting taxonomy, classification standards, and data quality direction while partnering with the offshore data management team on execution.
- Keeps the spend cube trusted — directing the offshore team on gap resolution, unmapped suppliers, and miscategorized transactions so category managers can rely on the numbers.
- Delivers actionable intelligence to category managers — supplier concentration, price and volume movement, tail spend, and maverick spend — packaged as recommendations and savings hypotheses, not dashboard exports.
- Drives the analytics roadmap — determining what views and opportunity pipelines the business needs, then working with vendors and the offshore team to build and maintain them.

The Person:
- 5+ years in procurement operations, systems, or source-to-pay — with hands-on experience configuring or administering at least one major platform (Coupa, SAP Ariba, Oracle, Jaggaer, or comparable).
- Working knowledge of spend analytics — taxonomy, supplier normalization, spend cubes, and category reporting; experience with Sievo or a comparable platform is a strong plus.
- Able to work at two altitudes — planning with leadership and executing in the system alongside users and technical partners.
- Strong communicator — able to translate data into clear recommendations for category managers, brief leadership, and train end users.
- Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, information systems, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience leading a system implementation, major upgrade, or process redesign from requirements through adoption.
- Familiarity with integrations (APIs, middleware, file feeds), identity/access, and analysis tools such as SQL, Excel at an advanced level, Power BI, or Tableau.
- Experience managing classification rules, exception queues, and data quality SLAs on a spend analytics platform.

Competencies
- Owns the mission after intent is set.
- Bias to action: moves work forward, closes loops, and makes the next step obvious.
- Technical fluency: willing to open the system, reproduce the issue, inspect the spend record, and stay with it until it is understood.
- Judgment: knows what to decide, what to escalate, and how to frame a clean recommendation.
- Influence without authority: aligns IT, finance, vendors, and business users around a single plan.
- Operational discipline: documentation, controls, and follow-through matter as much as speed.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. jobs.title: Chief Ethics & Compliance Officer, Asia Region
jobs.description:
Chief Ethics & Compliance Officer, Asia Region (Manufacturing)

Position Summary

The  Chief Ethics & Compliance Officer, Asia Region  leads the regional ethics and compliance program across  China, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia  for a manufacturing enterprise with complex supply chains, third-party ecosystems, and multi-site operations. This role designs, implements, and continuously improves a risk-based compliance framework to identify, prevent, detect, and respond to compliance risks, while strengthening a culture of integrity and accountability across the region.

A core mandate is to partner with senior leadership and operational teams (including plant and supply chain leadership) to embed compliance into day-to-day decisions and processes, and to foster an environment where employees raise concerns without fear of retaliation.

Reporting Relationship
- Reports to:  VP, Chief Ethics & Compliance Officer
- Key partners: Asia Regional President/GM, Country Leaders, Plant Leadership, Supply Chain/Procurement, Legal, HR, Finance, Internal Audit, Security, and EHS (as applicable)

Geographic Scope
- Primary coverage:  China, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia, Philippines
- Travel: Regular regional travel required (based on site footprint and risk profile)

Key Responsibilities

1) Regional Program Strategy, Governance, and Leadership
- Develop and execute a  regional ethics and compliance strategy  aligned to global standards and tailored to local regulatory and operational realities across Asia.
- Establish strong  governance and operating rhythms  (e.g., regional compliance committee cadence, country compliance reviews, escalation protocols, KPI reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer).
- Serve as the senior regional advisor to leadership on ethics and compliance risk, trends, and mitigation strategies.

2) Compliance Risk Management (Manufacturing-Focused)
- Lead a risk-based program to manage and mitigate compliance risks, including but not limited to: - Anti-bribery and anti-corruption (ABAC)  program management (gifts/hospitality, travel, sponsorships/donations, interactions with government officials, facilitation payment prevention, books-and-records controls).
- Trade controls, sanctions, and export compliance  (restricted party screening, end-use/end-user controls, cross-border shipments, technology transfers, customs and classification risks).
- Supplier, distributor, and other third-party relationship risks , including due diligence, contracting standards, ongoing monitoring, and controls around agents/intermediaries.
- Procurement integrity and conflicts of interest , including sourcing decisions, tender integrity, and supplier onboarding governance.
- Manufacturing site and operations-related compliance risks , including risks arising from local permitting/inspections, use of customs brokers, logistics providers, and interactions with local authorities (in coordination with Legal and relevant functions).

- Conduct and oversee  regional and country-level compliance risk assessments , incorporating site footprint, third-party concentration, and regulatory change.
- Define, implement, and continuously improve  controls, monitoring, and testing  in partnership with Internal Audit and process owners.

3) Third-Party and Supply Chain Compliance Oversight
- Own the regional approach to  third-party lifecycle management  (risk-tiering, due diligence, approvals, contract clauses, training/communications, and ongoing monitoring).
- Partner with Supply Chain/Procurement to embed compliance requirements into supplier selection, onboarding, performance management, and remediation plans.
- Strengthen oversight of high-risk third parties (e.g., distributors, sales agents, customs brokers, freight forwarders, and key suppliers).

4) Investigations, Case Management, and Remediation
- Oversee and/or conduct investigations into alleged misconduct, ensuring appropriate triage, confidentiality, documentation, and timely resolution.
- Ensure consistent regional  case management standards , including root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.
- Coordinate with HR and Legal on disciplinary actions and remediation; ensure control enhancements are implemented and sustained.

5) Culture of Integrity, Leadership Engagement, and Speak-Up Environment
- Work with senior management to ensure visible, sustained engagement on compliance at all levels, including plant and functional leadership.
- Foster an  open reporting environment  where employees and third parties raise concerns without fear of retaliation; reinforce non-retaliation expectations through leadership messaging, training, and case handling practices.
- Monitor reporting trends (hotline and other channels) to identify cultural barriers, systemic issues, and emerging risks; implement targeted interventions and communications.

6) Training, Communications, and Capability Building
- Ensure effective deployment of  risk-based and role-based training  across the region, including targeted training for high-risk roles (e.g., sales, procurement, logistics, plant leadership) and third parties where appropriate.
- Develop culturally relevant communications that translate expectations into practical guidance for manufacturing and supply chain contexts.
- Build a strong compliance talent bench and develop local capability through coaching, standards, and knowledge sharing.

7) People Leadership and Team Development (Direct Reports)
- Lead and develop a regional compliance team (direct reports), including goal setting, performance management, coaching, and succession planning.
- Establish clear team operating mechanisms, workload prioritization, and consistent standards across countries/sites.
- Manage the regional compliance budget and resource planning (as applicable).

8) Reporting, Metrics, and Executive Communication
- Provide regular reporting to the  Chief Compliance Officer  on program maturity, key risks, investigations, hotline trends, audit findings, and remediation progress.
- Maintain a regional compliance dashboard with actionable KPIs (e.g., due diligence coverage, training completion, monitoring results, time-to-close cases, repeat-issue rates).

Qualifications and Experience

Required
- Bachelor’s degree required (Law, Business, Finance, Engineering, International Relations, or related field).
- Extensive experience leading ethics and compliance programs in a multinational environment, with meaningful coverage of Asia markets.
- Demonstrated expertise in  ABAC ,  trade controls/export compliance , and  third-party/supplier compliance .
- Proven people leadership experience (leading managers and/or professional teams).
- Strong investigation and remediation leadership, with sound judgment and discretion.
- Ability to influence senior leaders and drive change across a matrixed, multi-site manufacturing organization.

Preferred
- Advanced degree (JD, MBA, or equivalent) and/or compliance certifications (e.g., CCEP, CCEP-I).
- Experience supporting manufacturing operations and supply chains across  China, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia .
- Experience implementing compliance monitoring/analytics and third-party due diligence tools.

Core Competencies
- Strategic, risk-based program leadership
- Executive presence; ability to challenge and influence constructively
- Cultural intelligence and cross-border leadership effectiveness
- Operational rigor (controls, monitoring, metrics)
- Investigation discipline and confidentiality
- Clear communication and training design for frontline/site audiences
- Commitment to speak-up culture and non-retaliation

Die Rolle:
Für den Bereich National Construction Enterprise & Rental wird zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt ein dynamischer und engagierter Business Development Manager (m/w/d) gesucht. In dieser Rolle tragen Sie die strategische sowie kommerzielle Verantwortung für Ihr Portfolio, betreuen bestehende Endkunden und gewinnen proaktiv neue Potenzialkunden, um diese zu langfristigen Partnern zu entwickeln. Durch Ihre Markt- und Produktsegment-Expertise beraten Sie Kunden bedarfsgerecht und entwickeln eigenständig Konzepte für die Listung in deren Warenwirtschaftssystemen. Zudem arbeiten Sie eng mit anderen kommerziellen Bereichen zusammen, um die Value Proposition der SBD-Profimarken zu stärken. Ihr Handeln ist von unternehmerischem Weitblick sowie nachhaltigem Beziehungsaufbau geprägt, wobei Sie als agiler Teamplayer auch tatkräftig bei Messen und Events vor Ort unterstützen.
Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören außerdem:
- Neukundengewinnung und Ausbau bestehender Endkunden in strategischen Zielmärkten

- Umsatz- und Margenverantwortung für das eigene Kundenportfolio

- Positionierung unserer Profimarken auf Endkundenebene

- Vertrieb von Elektro-, Handwerkzeugen und Aufbewahrungslösungen über definierte Handelspartner

- Durchführung von Produktdemonstrationen und Trainings beim Kunden

- Umsatzsteigerung durch Bedarfsanalysen und Sortimentsausweitung

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung nachhaltiger Kunden- und Vertriebskonzepte

- Sicherstellung von Listungen bei Endkunden sowie Abstimmung mit internen Schnittstellen

- Organisation von Events, Vorführungen sowie Dokumentation aller Aktivitäten in Salesforce

- Beobachtung von Markt-, Kunden- und Wettbewerbstrends

Ihr Profil:
- Betriebswirtschaftliches Studium oder kaufmännische/technische Ausbildung (z. B. Groß- und Außenhandelskaufmann/-frau) mit mehrjähriger Außendiensterfahrung im Bereich Elektrowerkzeuge oder werkzeugnaher Branchen, idealerweise in einem internationalen Unternehmen
- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Außendienst für Werkzeuge bzw. Elektrowerkzeuge oder verwandte Branchen

- Verhandlungsstärke und Gespür für Wachstumschancen

- Betriebswirtschaftliches Denken und Handeln

- Erfahrung im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte

- Technisches Verständnis für professionelle Elektro- und Handwerkzeuge sowie Zubehör

- Souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Ansprechpartnern auf allen Ebenen sowie in Vertragsverhandlungen

- Ehrgeiz, Zielstrebigkeit und Begeisterungsfähigkeit

- Kommunikationsstärke

- Hohe strategische und konzeptionelle Kompetenz sowie Organisationstalent

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

- Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse

- Überdurchschnittlich hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands

Was wir Ihnen bieten:
- Flexibles Arbeiten & Erholung:  Gestalten Sie Ihren Arbeitstag individuell mit modernen, flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen und profitieren Sie von 30 Urlaubstagen.

- Finanzielle Sicherheit & Altersvorsorge:  Profitieren Sie von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, Entgeltumwandlung mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss und weiteren Vorsorgeleistungen.

- Gesundheit & Versicherung:  Freuen Sie sich auf umfassenden Schutz durch Unfall- und Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung – auch in Ihrer Freizeit.

- Mobilität & Nachhaltigkeit:  Nutzen Sie unser attraktives Bike-Leasing-Angebot für umweltbewusste und gesunde Mobilität.

- Training & Entwicklung:  Mit LinkedIn Learning und weiteren Lernangeboten können Sie sich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

- Exklusive Mitarbeitervorteile:  Profitieren Sie von 50–60 % Rabatt auf unsere Markenprodukte, Corporate Benefits sowie attraktiven Vergünstigungen auf Reisen, Events und vieles mehr.

- Familienfreundlichkeit & Engagement:  Wir unterstützen Sie dabei, Beruf und Familie in Einklang zu bringen, und fördern auch Ihr ehrenamtliches Engagement – auch finanziell.

Bei Stanley Black & Decker schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Hintergründe – unabhängig von Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, Behinderung, Alter oder sexueller Identität.

jobs.title: Amazon eTrade Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Position Title:  Amazon eTrade Marketing Manager
Location:  Barcelona, Spain
Work Model:   Hybrid
Employment:   Permanent

Come build your career.
What You’ll Do
As Amazon eTrade Marketing Manager, you’ll be part of EMEA-ANZ eCommerce team located across the region, reporting directly to the Amazon EU Commercial Director.

You’ll get to:
· Own the full sales cycle of our products on Amazon for the market/categories you are responsible for. From listing the product to building in collaboration with our partners the activation plan.
· You will analyse your market and see what brands and categories are most important and work with Amazon Key Account Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to drive performance in these categories
· Maximize our sell-out performance at Sourcing/Manufacturing PCOGS by owning the Glance Views, Conversion and ASP performances:
· Conversion: You will need to leverage your SEO/SEA knowledge, your expertise in using Amazon native tools and programs (Vendor Central, Vine, Bundling,…), Plan quantities to keep RepOOS% at its lowest, plan impactful deals to win market shares especially during key moments.
· Traffic: Engage with our agency to (i) brief them on our strategic priorities and pilot with them our advertising performance along our funnel (CPM, CTR,CPC, ROAS, CVR ..) and ensure a strong level of communication to optimize our campaigns with the help of the agency on a weekly basis.
· ASP: Ensure our trade-up is transparent to shoppers & we create cross-selling opportunities from one range to another.
· Report on weekly basis on the POS performance applying the Pareto & x5 Why approaches
· Continuously evolve and understand the online competitive landscape to secure the target channel position and develop best practices for e-Commerce/digital marketing organizations specific to Amazon
· Your contact at Amazon will the AVS in charge of your brands/categories at the European level.
· Actively defend our brand through Brand Registry in close collaboration with our legal department and our SBU teams.

Who You Are
You always strive to do a good job…but wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? You care about quality – at every level. You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. In fact, you embrace it.
· Doer mentality couple with the drive to get things done under time pressure
· Strong analytical skills to identify real drivers of performance
· Team spirit & Interpersonal skills
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are essential as well as in the language of the market you will represent
· Ability to expand skills and take on additional responsibility in the future
· Strong sense of the business to build and manage budgets, pricing strategies and ROI analysis
· Ability to manage a diverse range of stakeholders internally & externally
· Robust sense of ownership, skills to manage several projects at the same time while keeping your eyes on the key priorities.
· A taste for challenge

What You’ll Receive
You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan:
· Medical, dental, life, vision, wellness program, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off and tuition reimbursement.
· Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

How You’ll Feel

· Grow : Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

jobs.title: Channel Marketing Manager, Canal Moderno
jobs.description:
Channel Marketing Manager, Canal Moderno.
Mexico

Ven a hacer del mundo un lugar mejor y acelera tu éxito.

Se necesitan grandes personas para lograr la grandeza. Personas con un sentido de propósito e integridad. Personas con una búsqueda incansable de la excelencia. Personas que se preocupan por mejorar las cosas Para Quienes Hacen el Mundo™. ¿Te identificas? Únete a nuestro equipo de más de 50,000 profesionales diversos y de alto rendimiento a nivel mundial que están dejando su huella en algunas de las marcas más queridas del mundo, incluyendo DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET® y HUSTLER®.

El Puesto:

Como Channel Marketing Manager, Canal Moderno formarás parte de nuestro equipo Marketing trabajando como empleado híbrido. Tendrás la oportunidad de:

- Liderar el desarrollo e implementación de estrategias comerciales y de ejecución del canal moderno, con una visión 100% orientada a resultados.

- Es responsable de la correcta articulación entre marketing, ventas y ejecución en punto de venta, apalancando datos, indicadores y análisis de mercado para acelerar el sell-out, ganar participación y asegurar una ejecución impecable en nuestros clientes.

- Adaptar la ejecución a las particularidades de cada punto de venta acorde al tipo de cliente.

- Alinear los objetivos comerciales, de sell-out y de desarrollo de canal, entre el equipo de Mkt y ventas.

- Analizar data de sell-out, cobertura, share, precios y promociones para identificar oportunidades.

- Desarrollar dashboards y presentar análisis ejecutivos con recomendaciones.

- Recopilar información y feedback del campo sobre la aceptación y efectividad de las estrategias.

- Construir junto con marketing y ventas los planes trimestrales de canal (activaciones, lanzamientos, promociones y exhibiciones).

- Coordinar recursos internos y externos (proveedores, logística, equipo comercial) para la correcta implementación de cada iniciativa, midiendo ROI, incremento de sell-out y participación en el punto de venta de dichas iniciativas.

- Proponer ajustes basados en datos y evolución del mercado.

Quién eres.

Siempre te esfuerzas por hacer un buen trabajo... pero ¿no sería genial si pudieras hacer tu trabajo y además generar un impacto positivo en el mundo? Te importa la calidad, en todos los niveles. Te encanta aprender, crecer y que reconozcan tus valiosas contribuciones. No te intimida la innovación; de hecho, la abrazas. Además, cuentas con:

- Experiencia previa en Trade marketing o ventas, deseable en el sector ferretero o automotriz.

- Conocimiento sólido de marketing, promoción de ventas y técnicas de trade marketing.

- Desarrollo de planes estratégicos a corto y mediano plazo, así como su implementación, seguimiento y análisis de resultados.

- Realización de briefs para agencias de materiales promocionales, publicidad y activaciones.

- Manejo y control de presupuesto e inventarios.

- Manejo de bases de datos.

Los Detalles

Recibirás un salario competitivo y un excelente paquete de beneficios.

Y mas!

Queremos que nuestra empresa sea un lugar donde quieras estar y quedarte. Ser parte de nuestro equipo significa que podrás:

- Crecimiento: Sé parte de nuestra empresa global con más de 20 marcas para crecer y desarrollar tus habilidades a lo largo de múltiples trayectorias profesionales.

- Aprendizaje: Accede a una gran variedad de recursos de aprendizaje, incluido nuestro portal digital de formación.

- Pertenencia: Disfruta de un excelente lugar para trabajar, donde existe un respeto mutuo y una gran valoración por la diversidad de perspectivas y experiencias.

- Contribuir: Ayúdanos a seguir generando cambios positivos a nivel local y global a través del voluntariado, el compromiso social y prácticas empresariales sostenibles.

Además, sentirás ese orgullo que proviene de empoderar a creadores, hacedores, protectores y héroes cotidianos en todo el mundo. Somos más que la empresa número uno en herramientas. Más que una fuerza impulsora en equipos de energía para exteriores. Más que un líder global en el sector industrial. Somos visionarios e innovadores. The Regional Sales Manager is responsible for working closely with the government vertical within the industrial sales team.  This role works directly with FED and SLED end user customers, SBD distributor partners and sales teams that focus on the government vertical. The ideal candidate will take full ownership of the Sales Cycle which includes building, maintaining and developing relationships, creating presentations & delivering content, forecasting  sales review and promotional planning. The candidate will be expected to continuously review/understand the competitive landscape to assist with our strategic planning and overall account management. You'll get to:

Account Management
- Develop and maintain strong strategic relationships with key personnel within assigned accounts. Regular planning and communication required
- National customer travel required; occasional domestic travel to attend internal business meetings also required
- Meet and Exceed Sales Goals
- Drive conversions and sell-through in the assigned region
- Help to negotiate and/or action annual customer Agreements and or National Programs
- Work with field account managers to gain understanding of regional and local needs
- Support and communicate with field teams on a regular basis to provide support needed to grow in the field
- Review business with customer on a monthly/quarterly basis to ensure growth targets being achieved
- Focus on Core Accounts that will drive the greatest impact and deliver results the quickest
- Shorten Sales Cycle by aligning our solutions that fit the needs of the customer | Customize programs/deals and time stamp it to create that urge to buy

Event Marketing and Training
- Provide support to end-users on product training through educational and safety seminars
- Work with SBD Sales and Marketing Teams to create and drive field programs and events to drive sales and educate end users on SBD product lines

- Develop event promos, flyers, based on customers national event schedule

Business Acumen & Partnership

- Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

- Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

The Local HR Manager /HR Country Leader serves as the primary Human Resources partner for T&O Thailand manufacturing site, providing both strategic HR leadership and hands-on operational support while driving consistency and harmonization of HR operations in country as country HR leader

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Business Partnership
- Partner with functional leaders to align HR priorities with business objectives.
- Provide strategic counsel on organization design, workforce planning, talent needs, and change management.
- Drive a high-performance, inclusive, and values-based culture.

Talent and Organization
- Partner with leaders to identify talent gaps and implement development actions.
- Support recruitment and onboarding processes to ensure timely and effective hiring.
- Champion employee development, learning, and career growth initiatives such as talent review, succession planning etc.

Employee Relations and Manager Support
- Serve as the primary advisor to managers on employee relations matters, performance management, and policy interpretation.

- Support resolution of employee concerns, investigations, disciplinary actions, and performance improvement processes as appropriate.

H R Op erations and Policy Execution

Summary: We are looking for an extraordinary sales person to join our Mac Tools sales team. The role of District Manager is responsible for developing a distributor’s business and for conducting training and field meetings with their assigned territories in addition to successfully on-boarding new distributors and conducting route surveys within the territory. The District Manager is responsible for the sales and growth of the assigned territory.

Essential Job Functions:
- Achieve annual operating plan by working with distributors to increase route averages and recruiting new distributors into the territory
- Conduct effective work-with’s (truck ride a-longs) 3-4 days per week to provide coaching and support to distributors in the territory
- Attract and retain distributors into the Mac Tools business
- Conduct new franchisee training (2 week ride-along for new Distributors). Completes field start process with all new Distributors and revisits as needed to develop/coach as directed by Regional Manager and Regional Business Analyst

- Participate at Student Tech shows
- Manage regional credits and adjustments
- Perform route surveys for all new starts as well as surveys at the request of the Regional Manager
- Perform other duties as assigned

Key Metrics:
- District Sales Plan
- Distributor Success (route averages, % growing, % > 150K, etc.)
- Regional Retention

Essential Skills & Experience:
- Must have minimum of 5 years of route / field sales experience
- Must have minimum of 2 years management experience directing multiple field / route sales professionals
- Willingness to travel up to 80% within the specified sales territory
- Willingness to live in the sales territory
- Willingness to submit to a drug test and background investigation including a verification of your past employment criminal history, educational background, and driving record
- Unrestricted authorization to work within the United States without sponsorship

Desired Characteristics:
- BA in business or related field
- Prior experience in the mobile tool sales industry
- Demonstrated success in recruiting new talent into an organization
- Strong organizational skills
- Proven time management skills and strong business acumen and relationship building skills
- Knowledge of the local automotive repair market
- Prior experience as a small business owner or in coaching mentoring small business owners

(All lifting and/or maneuvering performed must comply with the proper safety techniques established and communicated by The Stanley Black & Decker EHS program.)
- *Must be able to always (95% - 100%) lift and maneuver 20 pounds in any range of motion combination from ground/ankle height through above shoulder height.
- *Must be able to frequently (65% - 90%) lift and maneuver 35 pounds in any range of motion combination from ground/ankle height through above shoulder height.
- *Must be able to often (35% - 60%) lift and maneuver 45 pounds in any range of motion combination from ground/ankle height through above shoulder height.

- *Must be able to move (60% - 75%) around the inside of a tool truck.
- *Must be able to climb and descend stairs for a minimum of 20 times per work-with
- Exposed to various work environments; on tools trucks conducting distributor work with’s (60%), traveling in a vehicle

(20%) and time spent in home office (20%).
- This position works (50%) in outdoor weather conditions.
- This position may occasionally have to position themselves in low positions and/or under objects.
- Constantly operates a vehicle, as well as various office equipment such as laptop and mobile phone in both an office and travel environment.
- Must be able to communicate in person, as this position frequently communicates with distributors and must be able to exchange accurate information, as well as strong written communication skills.

United States
50% Travel

In this role you are responsible for assisting in increasing sales and market share through the creation and execution of a sales plan in the territory.

- Working to achieve revenue targets and KPI’s such as product quotas, yearly sales quotas, NPD sales requirements, minimum quote funnel requirement, as set by the business
- Communicate and coordinate activities with Regional Sales Manager, other Territory Sales Manager, Segment Managers, National Distribution Manager, and any other representatives who could assist with a project or account
- Develop a complete knowledge and understanding of all the Vidmar® and LISTA® products
- Conduct distributor and end user product training on all products and offerings including existing product, new product, and additional services (literature, Digital Applications & Tools)
- Develop and leverage distributor partnership to meet assigned Territory revenue targets
- Manage and operate within a specific Travel and Entertainment budget
- Abide by any and all Stanley Black & Decker Business Conduct rules and regulations
- Traveling duties consist of calling on end users and distribution, meeting and working with local TSM’s, to drive sales within a region.
- Limited additional travel (outside of territory) may be required for training and company-wide meetings.

jobs.title: Lead Category Manager, Finished Goods
jobs.description:
Global Procurement – Lead Category Manager for Finished Goods

JOB DESCRIPTION
The Lead Category Manager (LCM) role within Global Procurement is focused on the effective and efficient procurement of finished goods products, with a primary focus on Hand Tools (sub-categories with Consumer Fastening and Handtools) , in support of Stanley Black & Decker's vision. This role is responsible for defining, leading, and monitoring holistic supplier and category strategies, driving sourcing productivity, and delivering year-over-year productivity and working capital goals. The role manages direct material spend of up to approximately $50M and interacts with suppliers and colleagues across geographies and work cultures.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategic Supplier Management
- Establish, maintain, and develop strong relationships with key global suppliers to ensure quality, cost, delivery, and productivity targets are met.
- Serve as an escalation point to resolve supplier performance issues.
- Establish regular communication cadence with strategic suppliers.
- Initiate and implement Supplier Days (supplier workshops / Kaizen events).
- Support, organize, and participate in supplier conferences and summits.
- Implement strategic supplier management, supplier risk management, supplier diversity, and CSR programs (leveraging Global Procurement's Center of Excellence).
- Develop and foster global supplier relationships that deliver cost reduction, supply assurance, quality improvement, and innovation.

2. Category & Material Field Strategy
- Define, lead, and monitor global supplier and category strategies, with a focus on categories within Consumer Fastening & Layout .
- Independently develop future-oriented strategies and purchasing concepts aligned with the company's global orientation, with the aim of cross-plant application.
- Consider unique/specific SBU needs during category strategy implementation; provide SBU expertise to category and regional leadership.
- Understand and link category/sourcing strategy with Global Procurement priorities and SBU goals.
- Implement category strategies in support of the business vision and margin resiliency initiatives.
- Maintain and control correct supplier classification in product groups and subgroups (SIEVO).
- Drive reduction in the number of suppliers and bundling of purchasing volumes.
- Institutionalize best-practice processes, policies, and knowledge sharing between Global Procurement and SBU to ensure continuous improvement.

3. Negotiations & Contract Management
- Negotiate, implement, and manage supplier contracts and service level agreements.
- Ensure contract compliance (internal approval process), signature regulations, and registration in the group-wide database.
- Monitor markets and trends to proactively renegotiate prices with suppliers.
- Analyze and negotiate price adjustments by suppliers.

4. Tenders, Benchmarks & Sourcing Execution
- Lead the supplier selection process through management of formal RFP, RFQ, and RFI processes.
- Carry out price comparisons to optimize the procurement situation; initiate price and value analyses, substitution of parts/materials as needed.
- Accompany new part projects in cooperation with development from the product development phase to achieve cost reductions.
- Utilize modern purchasing tools (eRFQ, eAuctions, Should Costing).
- Create TCO value through a combination of productivity, working capital, synergies, reduced risk, and improved supplier lead times.

5. Program & Project Management
- Lead and drive program management for core initiatives in Productivity, Working Capital, and Supplier Performance.
- Plan and implement programs/projects including complex large-scale initiatives; define content, goals, and individual milestones.
- Coordinate and monitor milestones, interfaces, dates, and services (internal and external); initiate corrective measures as needed.
- Ensure New Ways of Sourcing are utilized and state-of-the-art reports are developed and implemented (e.g., Power BI, Smartsheet).
- Lead individuals and teams to deliver results; reporting relationships may be solid, dotted, or team-based.

6. Other Responsibilities
- Ensure a high degree of service delivery and SBU satisfaction; partner with SBUs to ensure they recognize the business value from the Global Procurement team.
- Ensure suitable control measures and KPIs are in place to measure progress and derive corrective action plans.
- Support operations (planning, tactical purchasing) in the context of supplier escalations (delivery bottlenecks, quality problems, etc.).
- Conduct Make vs. Buy evaluations of key product lines in support of business strategies.
- Assist in the identification and execution of negotiated inventory programs.
- Support acquisition integration projects including due diligence, opportunity assessments, sub-team participation, delivery of synergy targets, and overall project management of sourcing initiatives.
- Guarantee compliance with Global Procurement /GSS policies, procedures, and DoA/DOA requirements.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS
- Strong listening, coaching, and influencing skills; ability to influence without direct authority.
- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels, particularly at the management level; executive presence and effective presentation skills.
- Excellent negotiation skills and knowledge of procurement and sourcing techniques, supplier integration, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Strong financial and analytical skills; experience in strategic planning, budgeting, and financial reporting.
- Ability to conceive strategic program initiatives, plan, sell ideas, and execute.
- Proven track record of developing and executing successful YOY productivity projects and complex sourcing/procurement strategies.
- Proficiency in MS Office, Power BI, and Smartsheet.
- Strong project and program management and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work in a matrixed environment, managing multiple and often conflicting priorities.
- Highly self-motivated with the ability to drive change in a global organization with minimum supervision.
- Multi-lingual capability is a plus.

CERTIFICATIONS (Preferred)
- CPIM or CSCMP certification
- PMP certification
- Six Sigma or Lean/Kaizen certification

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
- 5+ years of experience in Global Procurement / Strategic Sourcing organizations, including supplier selection, supplier management, and contract negotiations.
- Minimum 5 years of category strategy or material field strategy experience.
- Balance of both strategic and operational capacities including regional sourcing, supplier management, and commodity risk management.
- Successful track record of designing and implementing complex sourcing and procurement strategies that achieved desired results within the category.
- Global mindset with experience working in an international/multi-cultural matrix environment.

EDUCATION
- Bachelor's degree required.
- MBA or Master's degree in Supply Chain preferred.

TRAVEL
Must be willing to travel domestically and internationally 10–20% of the time.
